---
title: "Overview"
---

```{python}
from datetime import date

import polars as pl
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    geom_col,
    geom_text,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_fill_gradient,
    theme_classic,
)

run_overview_df = pl.read_csv("data/derived/run_overview.csv", try_parse_dates=True)
runs_by_year_df = pl.read_csv("data/derived/runs_by_year.csv")

run_overview = run_overview_df.row(0, named=True)
first_run_date = run_overview["first_run_date"]
latest_run_date = run_overview["latest_run_date"]
duration = f"{((latest_run_date - first_run_date).days):,} days"


def format_date(value: date) -> str:
    return value.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")


def format_pace(seconds: float) -> str:
    minutes, remaining_seconds = divmod(round(seconds), 60)
    return f"{minutes}:{remaining_seconds:02d}/mi"
```

## Yearly

```{python}
runs_by_year_df = runs_by_year_df.with_columns(
    pl.col("year").cast(pl.Int64),
    pl.col("total_distance_miles").cast(pl.Float64),
)

latest_year_note = (
    "year to date"
    if latest_run_date.year == date.today().year
    else "latest recorded year"
)

(
    ggplot(
        runs_by_year_df,
        aes(
            x="year",
            y="total_distance_miles",
            fill="aggregate_moving_pace_seconds_per_mile",
        ),
    )
    + geom_col(width=0.8)
    + geom_text(
        aes(label="total_distance_miles"),
        va="bottom",
        size=6,
        format_string="{:,.0f} mi",
    )
    + scale_fill_gradient(
        low="#0d6efd",
        high="#b8daff",
        labels=lambda values: [format_pace(value) for value in values],
    )
    + labs(
        title="Distance by Year",
        subtitle=(
            f"{latest_run_date.year} is the {latest_year_note}, "
            f"through {format_date(latest_run_date)}"
        ),
        x="Year",
        y="Distance (mi)",
        fill="Moving pace",
    )
    + theme_classic()
)
```

## Footer

Data covers `{python} format_date(first_run_date)` through `{python} format_date(latest_run_date)` (`{python} duration`).
